messages:
marie: noticed more 413s from big batch uploads this morning. customers sending mixed-dim arrays and giant single records. thought we had preflight, but it's noisy.
raju: yeah, preflight helps but it's too coarse. we need size-aware backpressure + per-item priority so small latency-sensitive items aren't blocked by a few huge items.
tom: proposal: two-phase ingress ack: preflight returns a plan with per-item route hints and an estimated token_cost + suggested_split_size for oversize items. header: X-Embed-Preflight: plan_id=..., expires=60s.
kelsey: UX: console should show a simulated cost/latency for sampled requests using the preflight plan. customers can toggle "apply suggested splits automatically".
zane: runtime: implement per-tenant priority queues inside ingress shard. Items tagged high_priority go to fastpath, low_priority go to background batching. Keep total concurrency cap per-tenant.
marie: how determine priority? SDK can set priority per-item (hint) and we do a server-side heuristic: if request header X-Embed-Priority present keep it, otherwise auto-promote small_items where bytes < 2KB to high_priority.
raju: need fairness: when low_priority fills up, we should shed or return polite backpressure instead of simply delaying. Return 429 with body explaining suggested split and backoff header: Retry-After: seconds and X-Embed-Suggest-Split: 512.
tom: edge cases: mixed dims in same batch. We must never combine dims in same compute batch. Preflight must include grouping by dim: e.g. groups: [{dims:128, count:5},{dims:64,count:2}].
kelsey: telemetry checklist: preflight_count, preflight_hit_ratio, preflight_plan_apply_rate, oversize_413_rate, per_item_priority_ratio, queue_latency_ms_p95 per priority. Add synthetic trace for preflight->ingest->compute for tracing.
zane: quota interaction: when preflight suggests splits it should deduct an estimate from quota but mark it as "provisional" until compute completes. This avoids double-billing when client follows split plan. We need a reconciliation window and events like provisional_charge_rollback.
marie: security/compliance: caching preflight plans may leak payload shapes. TTL=30s, don't include tenant payload example. ok?
raju: console features: 1) "Request simulator" that uploads a sample batch and shows preflight plan with cost & latency estimate, 2) "Quota budgeter" where org admins can set budget for high_priority paths, 3) alerts when provisional_charge_rollback rate > 0.5%.
tom: API sketch: POST /v1/embeddings: ?apply_plan=true header X-Embed-Preflight: plan_id=... OR POST /v1/embeddings/preflight -> {"items":[{"id":"a","bytes":345,"dims":128},...]} returns plan JSON.
kelsey: rollout: feature-flag embed.preflight.v2. Stage 0: telemetry-only for all tenants. Stage 1: preflight advisory (no apply). Stage 2: enable apply_plan for opt-in tenants. Stage 3: default apply for small orgs. FF toggles should be per-org.
zane: runtime perf: preflight cheap path must be <5ms p50. So do shape-only hash and size estimates, no full vector parsing. If SDK sends explicit bytes field we can skip parsing.
marie: SDK changes: add EmbeddingsClient.preflight(items) helper that computes bytes and dims locally and sends minimal payload. Also helper to split-large-items automatically with policy.
raju: dashboard KPIs: "High-priority latency" and "Low-priority throughput" side-by-side, "Oversize rejection trend", "Avg preflight plan apply savings". Provide an exportable CSV for finance.
tom: failure modes: if plan_id expired when applied, return 428 (Precondition Required) with reason plan_expired. If client ignores suggested split and causes 413, return 413 with X-Embed-Suggest-Split header with byte suggestion.
kelsey: customer communication: put console banner when preflight is enabled: "Embedding preflight is now available. Try the simulator." Also show estimated savings in billing preview but mark as estimated until reconciliation window passes.
zane: instrumentation: emit trace span name embed.preflight and tags {plan_id, tenant_id, items_group_count, preflight_latency_ms}. Metrics: preflight_apply_success_rate.
marie: ops: ensure ingress maintains per-tenant queue memory caps; metric queue_mem_bytes and queue_item_count. Add auto-evict policy: drop oldest low_priority when memory > threshold and emit dropped_item metric.
raju: quotas: introduce "priority_budget" in console where admin sets tokens per day for high_priority; excess moves items to low_priority automatically. Show forecast widget.
tom: example error payload for 429: ```json
{
  "error":"ingress_backpressure",
  "retry_after":30,
  "suggest_split_bytes":512
}
```
kelsey: rollout tracking: metrics-bot: please chart preflight_advisory_uptake by org.
metrics-bot: queued chart job accepted: job_id=pf-20260322-77, will be available in console under /dashboards/preflight-uptake in ~5m.
zane: small implementation note: grouping by dims + priority key: hash = dims << 32 | priority. Use that for quick bucket assignment.
marie: action items: (1) API + SDK spec (tom + kelsey) (2) runtime queue prototype (raju + zane) (3) console simulator + quota UI (kelsey + console-team) (4) telemetry dashboards (metrics-bot + console-team) (5) legal/compliance check on plan caching (marie).
raju: I'll prototype queueing and 429 body this afternoon and put a canary.
metrics-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started service=embed-ingress tag=preflight-queue-proto id=canary-20260322-2 :rocket:
metrics-bot: deploy success service=embed-ingress id=canary-20260322-2 host=ingress-08
kelsey: filed RFC draft and linked it: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/embed-preflight-priority (WIP)
marie: great. let's reconvene after the canary runs for ~1 hour. please ping thread with first-hour numbers.
raju: will do. :thumbsup:
